datasheet_identity.title: AP4606C N+P-Channel Power MOSFET Data Sheet

extraction_notes: This single-target extraction covers the N-channel die of the complementary N+P AP4606C; the P-channel die is not represented because the strict schema permits one polarity per object.
All tabulated electrical characteristics are from the N-channel table headed Ta = 25 degC. Signed values in the P-channel table were not transferred into this N-channel target.
Transfer, output, and capacitance curves were digitized from the supplied public datasheet figures using plotted points only. The transfer curve uses the 25 degC trace.
The datasheet publishes typical Ciss, Coss, and Crss at VDS = 10 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz; capacitance-versus-VDS traces are also available in Fig. 7.
No gate-resistance, reverse-recovery-time, or thermal-junction-to-case value is published for the N-channel table in the supplied datasheet.
The N-channel table gives IDSS maximum 1 uA at VDS = 20 V and VGS = 0 V, but IDSS is not a field in the strict extraction schema.
